plans.goal: Ring the chapel bell to stun all enemies within range, then grab the reliquary unopposed
steps: Send Pip north to the bell-rope on the chapel's far wall
Ring the bell to rattle and stun all foes within 7 tiles, stripping their readied actions
While enemies are rattled, push into the chapel center
Secure the silver reliquary from the altar
Carry it west out of the chapel using rubble and walls as cover

atoms.text: Pip, get to that chapel bell-rope and ring it when you're set
When the bell rings, that's my window to move in
I'm moving in for the reliquary on the altar
Taking shelter behind the fallen log while I grab it
I've got the reliquary, moving fast
Everyone west, away from the chapel—cover me

plans.goal: Topple the leaning pillar to create a mobile barrier and crushing zone between you and the foes
steps: Maneuver to the eastern side of the chapel where the pillar leans
Topple the pillar to crush and block enemy advancement
Use the fallen pillar as both cover and battering ram concept
Slip in behind the rubble to grab the reliquary
Carry it back west, using the pillar as a shield against counterattack

atoms.text: Moving to the leaning pillar on the east wall
The fallen pillar blocks their advance—hold here
Now I slip in and grab the reliquary from the altar
Got it—staying low, using the rubble as shield
Fall back west, the pillar blocks their pursuit

plans.goal: Ring the bell and topple the pillar together for overwhelming chaos—then calmly take the reliquary
steps: Pip prepares the bell-rope while you position at the pillar
Ring the bell and topple the pillar at nearly the same moment
Enemies are both stunned AND blocked by collapsing stone
Maximum confusion: enemies lose actions AND lose clear approach
Walk in and secure the silver reliquary unopposed

Topple the leaning pillar—do it now, Pip ring that bell
